allowed_references.planetgen.generation.life:_set_descripti: writes the class's own description text onto the body; it claims no life (GEN.92)
allowed_references.planetgen.generation.life:decide_flavor_: picks the flavour line of a body; reads the conditions' class (classify) only to choose between planet and orbital flavour text, never to decide whether it lives
